settings.enableNumberFormatCache.name: Enable: Number Format Cache
settings.enableNumberFormatCache.hint: Reuse number formatters instead of building a new one for every number shown. dnd5e builds one for each weight, price, range and spell label, which slows down updating characters with many items or spells (about 15% of a big spellbook's recalculation). Numbers look exactly the same either way. Requires a reload.
